7. **Flip magnifier to side without wobble** ✓ - "i've heard of wobble problems with the others but not this one, when up it might have 2mm of movement due to the roll pin locking devise but you don't even notice it and when flip to side no movement at all"

This is clearly the product the user is looking for. The Sun Optics 30mm High Flip to Side Scope Mount (id: 135623) matches all the criteria perfectly.
